official_sources.finding: Workspaces are task-oriented predefined window layouts made of Areas containing Editors; workspaces can be duplicated, reordered and saved with the project.
Each Area can host an Editor type; multiple instances of the same editor can coexist.
Editors follow consistent regions such as header, toolbar, sidebar and navigation while retaining task-specific behavior.
Blender favors non-overlapping, non-blocking, mostly non-modal UI and separates data properties from tools.
Properties are context-sensitive to the active object/scene/tool and grouped by stable tabs.
Asset Browser provides catalogs, metadata/details, import modes and drag/drop organization.
Extensions should be self-contained, namespaced, avoid changing other extensions and honor online-access policy.
Recovery combines save versions, autosave, undo, redo and undo history.
UI actions are traceable from interface controls to operators/properties; editor operators live in explicit code areas.

factory_mapping.recommended_delta: Keep canvas-first shell but allow named task workspaces/presets as versioned state; do not create separate app instances.
Treat library/canvas/context as explicit regions with stable ownership and hide/show behavior; preserve shared project state.
Properties pane must derive strictly from selected entity/tool and write through canonical actions; no duplicate state engine.
Add catalog hierarchy/metadata/import provenance on top of existing search/filter/preview/favorites; reuse current component browser instead of adding another browser.
Every acquired component stays namespaced behind typed adapter/capability bus and cannot mutate other plugins or core directly.
Remote plugins declare network capability and remain disabled/fail-closed without approved endpoint/secret_ref.
Unify undo history, named snapshots and reload recovery under one visible recovery model without replacing existing store.
Every UI control maps to one canonical action/operator identifier so F-UI-051/055 can enumerate and test effect deterministically.

reason: All high-value Blender patterns map to capabilities already represented by Factory segments; immediate work is integration/standardization, not copying Blender or downloading its source tree.
handoff: SEG-01: use workspace/region model as UX acceptance guidance
SEG-02: enrich current component browser with catalogs/metadata only if F-FE-067 proves a gap
SEG-05: expose canonical action/operator ids for exhaustive controls tests
SEG-10/Fables: enforce extension isolation and capability declarations
